_comment: Generic Gemini CLI identity seed. Installation creates local continuity; authority is issued by the Hestia daemon and is never shipped here.

substrate.local_footprint: runtime identity and observation files under the configured Gemini home
substrate.persistence: local context; model sessions are ephemeral

mrh.scope_policy: No scope is shipped. The daemon vault and certified runtime snapshots are authoritative.
mrh.out_of_scope_note: Request any required scope from the installation operator.
